scripts.build: pnpm --filter @docfuse/markdown build && pnpm --filter docfuse build && pnpm --filter @docfuse/plugins build
scripts.dev:site: pnpm build && cd site && docfuse dev
scripts.preview:site: pnpm build && cd site && node ../packages/docfuse/dist/cli.js build && node ../packages/docfuse/dist/cli.js preview
scripts.test:browser-consumer: pnpm --filter @docfuse/markdown build && pnpm --filter @docfuse/plugins build && pnpm --filter @docfuse/markdown test:browser && pnpm --filter @docfuse/plugins test:browser
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @docfuse/markdown typecheck && pnpm --filter docfuse typecheck && pnpm --filter @docfuse/plugins typecheck && pnpm typecheck:site && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.test:release: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm audit:dependencies && pnpm build && pnpm exec vitest run --coverage && node --test tests/architecture/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @docfuse/markdown test:browser && pnpm --filter @docfuse/plugins test:browser && node scripts/test-packed-cli.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs --no-cache && pnpm audit:site && pnpm report:site && pnpm report:bundles && pnpm report:package && node scripts/benchmark-enterprise.mjs
